about.title: About Me
about.text:
Bachelor in applied computer engineering (Bacc. ing. comp.)
Software engineering graduate focused on backend development. Experienced in Java (Spring Boot), C#/.NET and Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, pandas). During my internship at MicroCache I worked on backend and frontend features with Spring Boot, React and PostgreSQL, containerized applications with Docker and worked in an agile team (Scrum, Kanban). I also build personal backend projects in Python with automated tests and CI.

items.desc: During the internship, I worked on web application development using modern development tools and processes:
bullets: Participating in deployment and testing processes
Introduction to DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, servers, deployment)
Working in an agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)

items.name: Sales Automation Lab
items.desc: REST API with JWT auth, CSV import and sales reports. Layered architecture, idempotent pandas ETL, tests in CI against SQLite and PostgreSQL.

items.name: Realtime Hospitality System
items.desc: Restaurant ordering system with admin, staff and kitchen roles and real-time order updates over WebSocket (STOMP). Spring Boot REST API with JWT auth and Flyway migrations, React and TypeScript web client, tests in GitHub Actions CI.

items.name: Information Systems Interoperability
items.desc: Spring Boot service for managing support tickets over REST, SOAP and GraphQL, with XML (XSD) and JSON Schema validation and JWT auth. Also includes a gRPC service for weather data from the DHMZ XML feed.

items.name: WorldCupStatsApp
items.desc: Desktop apps (WinForms and WPF) for World Cup data that share a library for reading data from a REST API or local JSON files. WinForms shows favorite players (drag and drop) and rankings by goals, yellow cards and attendance; WPF shows match starting lineups.

items.name: Sudoku JavaFX
items.desc: Sudoku game for one or two players; game state is exchanged over sockets and chat runs over RMI. Saving and loading games, recording moves to XML for replay and generating HTML documentation with reflection.

profile.title: Profile
items: Focused on backend development and practical, well-tested solutions.
Continuously learning, currently deepening Python and software architecture.
